description: A response that reconsiders R-1 to R-3 but leaves out R-4 is accepted for what it holds, and R-4 gets a REGEN-001 coverage event, which rejects no item.
section: IMPL §3.3.6 (REGEN-001: every affected recommendation exactly once; a missing one is invalidated as not_reconsidered), §3.5, §3.8 (a regeneration response that omits an affected recommendation)

actions.reason: The decision it relied on was superseded.
The change does not touch it.
